Players Committee card image of [[Cell 2187 (V)]], as first published (no errata mark), printing: “If Leia imprisoned, deploy on table. [Set 8] Luke is a spy and stormtrooper. Han, Leia, and Luke are immune to Nevar Yalnal and Put All Sections On Alert. Once per turn, may ▼ a Death Star site. Immune to This Is Some Rescue! [Immune to Alter.]” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/ee4c4cd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/cell_2187.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/cell_2187.png] as of commit ee4c4cd “Set 15 cards + errata images” (22 June 2021).
